VORE.Settings.AutoRoll.Name: Auto-roll for NPCs
VORE.Settings.AutoRoll.Hint: Off (default): the GM gets the same private roll dialog (skill, advantage/disadvantage) for NPC tokens. On: NPC tokens with no player owner roll automatically.
VORE.Settings.PlayersVore.Name: Players can start Vore checks
VORE.Settings.PlayersVore.Hint: When enabled, players can start a Vore check from the Token HUD or Token Controls for tokens they own. Players can always escape or release as allowed by the rules.
VORE.Settings.PlayersEdit.Name: Players can edit the Vore tab
VORE.Settings.PlayersEdit.Hint: Lets players edit the Vore tab on tokens and actors they own. They also need Foundry's 'Configure Token Settings' permission, and 'Use File Browser' to browse for images and sounds.
VORE.Settings.Smooth.Name: Smooth attach
VORE.Settings.Smooth.Hint: Prey tokens move in lockstep with the predator on every screen, like a child of the predator token. Turn this off if prey ever looks offset or jumps; prey will then follow with a short delay instead.
VORE.Settings.Size.Name: Size affects Vore checks
VORE.Settings.Size.Hint: The larger creature rolls its Vore/Escape check with advantage; if two or more sizes larger, the smaller one also rolls with disadvantage.
VORE.Settings.Strike.Name: Prey can strike from inside
VORE.Settings.Strike.Hint: Adds a 'Strike from within' button for prey. Enough damage to the predator from inside forces a Constitution save or everyone is released.
VORE.Settings.Threshold.Name: Breakout damage threshold
VORE.Settings.Threshold.Hint: Damage dealt to the predator from inside, within one round, that triggers the breakout save.
VORE.Settings.DC.Name: Breakout save DC
VORE.Settings.DC.Hint: Constitution save DC the predator must beat to keep prey inside.
VORE.Settings.DigestHeal.Name: Predator heals on digestion
VORE.Settings.DigestHeal.Hint: Off (default). On: when prey is digested the predator recovers a fraction of the prey's max HP and gains temporary HP.
VORE.Settings.HealDiv.Name: Digestion heal (Fraction mode): max HP divisor
VORE.Settings.HealDiv.Hint: 4 = heal 1/4 of the prey's max HP. Only used when 'Predator heals on digestion' is on.
VORE.Settings.TempDiv.Name: Digestion temp HP (Fraction mode): max HP divisor
VORE.Settings.TempDiv.Hint: 8 = gain temporary HP equal to 1/8 of the prey's max HP. Only used when healing is on.
VORE.Settings.TurnDice.Name: Digestion damage: number of dice
VORE.Settings.TurnDice.Hint: Dice rolled each predator turn (plus CON). The same number is added again for every step of levels below.
VORE.Settings.TurnSize.Name: Digestion damage: die size
VORE.Settings.TurnSize.Hint: Sides on each digestion damage die (6 = d6).
VORE.Settings.ChurnDice.Name: Churn damage: number of dice
VORE.Settings.ChurnDice.Hint: Dice rolled by Churn (plus CON). The same number is added again for every step of levels below.
VORE.Settings.ChurnSize.Name: Churn damage: die size
VORE.Settings.ChurnSize.Hint: Sides on each Churn die (6 = d6).
VORE.Settings.DiceEvery.Name: Extra dice every N levels
VORE.Settings.DiceEvery.Hint: Level (or CR) step at which digestion and Churn dice scale up.
VORE.Settings.Endo.Name: Allow Endo
VORE.Settings.Endo.Hint: Endo lets a predator hold prey without harming them (no per-turn damage, timer paused). Turn off to prevent its use; it also ignores any Endo already switched on.
VORE.Settings.Feeding.Name: Prey can feed themselves to predators
VORE.Settings.Feeding.Hint: Prey can offer themselves to a targeted predator. The predator allows it, or resists and the prey must win a Vore check.
VORE.Settings.HealMode.Name: Digestion heal: method
VORE.Settings.HealMode.Hint: Fraction: heal a fraction of the prey's max HP (divisors below). Dice: roll the dice below; temp HP is half the result.
VORE.Settings.HealDice.Name: Digestion heal: number of dice
VORE.Settings.HealSize.Name: Digestion heal: die size
VORE.Settings.Stomach.Name: Stomach rules (AC and HP)
VORE.Settings.Stomach.Hint: Off (default). On: each predator's stomach has its own AC and HP (set in the Vore tab; blank = automatic). Prey use 'Strike from within' to attack it, and breaking through releases everyone. Replaces the breakout-threshold rule.
VORE.Settings.MuffleRange.Name: Muffled chat range
VORE.Settings.MuffleRange.Hint: How far (in scene distance units, e.g. feet) a vored token's muffled speech carries. Players with no token that close hear nothing. The GM, the speaker and their bellymates always hear it. 0 = no limit.
VORE.Settings.Panel.Name: Show the Vore status panel
VORE.Settings.Panel.Hint: A small panel for you when your token is inside a predator, digested, or holding prey: who holds you, the timer, your HP and the actions that apply. Your own setting.
VORE.Settings.AutoFeatures.Name: Add Vore features to player characters
VORE.Settings.AutoFeatures.Hint: Gives every player character the six Vore features (Devour, Feed, Struggle, Churn, Release, Endo) once, including new characters. A character you remove them from is not given them again.
VORE.Settings.Log.Name: Keep a Vore Log journal
VORE.Settings.Log.Hint: Adds a GM-only journal called Vore Log with a page per scene and a timestamped line for every swallow, release and digestion.
VORE.Settings.Hud.Name: Show Vore buttons on the Token HUD
VORE.Settings.Hud.Hint: Off (default). All Vore actions are in the Vore Controls group. Turn on to also show them on the Token HUD.
VORE.Settings.DefPrey1.Name: Default prey token image (Vore option 1 only)
VORE.Settings.DefPrey1.Hint: Overrides the all-options default for Vore option 1 only.
VORE.Settings.DefDig1.Name: Default digested token image (Vore option 1 only)
VORE.Settings.DefDig1.Hint: Overrides the all-options default for Vore option 1 only.
VORE.Settings.DefSound1.Name: Default loop sound (Vore option 1)
VORE.Settings.DefSound1.Hint: Used by Vore option 1 when its own Sound is empty, including on existing tokens.
VORE.Settings.DefSwallow1.Name: Default swallow sound (Vore option 1)
VORE.Settings.DefSwallow1.Hint: Used by Vore option 1 when its own Swallow sound is empty.
VORE.Settings.DefEscape1.Name: Default escape / release sound (Vore option 1)
VORE.Settings.DefEscape1.Hint: Used by Vore option 1 when its own Escape / release sound is empty.
VORE.Settings.DefDigestSnd1.Name: Default digestion sound (Vore option 1)
VORE.Settings.DefDigestSnd1.Hint: Used by Vore option 1 when its own Digestion sound is empty.
VORE.Settings.Downed.Name: When a predator is downed
VORE.Settings.Downed.Hint: What happens to held prey when their predator drops to 0 HP or dies: release them (default), ask the GM, or leave them held.
